reception.title: Reception
reception.description: Register the patient, choose the tests, take payment and print the labels.
reception.replacedByPackage_one: {{count}} test is already in the package, so it was taken out of the list.
reception.replacedByPackage_other: {{count}} tests are already in the package, so they were taken out of the list.
reception.needPatient: Find or register the patient first.
reception.needDiscountReason: Write the reason for the discount (at least 3 characters).

success.title: Order registered
success.discountPending: The requested discount was sent for approval. It isn't deducted until a manager approves it.

finder.placeholder: Name, phone number or patient number…
finder.hint: Type at least two letters or digits. Arabic spelling variants are found too.

patient.birthRequired: Enter the birth date or the age.
patient.estimatedAge: Estimated from the age given at registration
patient.emailInvalid: This email address doesn't look right.
patient.notesHint: Chronic conditions, medicines (e.g. anticoagulants), allergies. Shown at every visit.
patient.mergedNotice: This record was merged into another one. New orders go on the remaining record.

duplicates.title_one: This patient may already be registered
duplicates.title_other: This patient may already be registered ({{count}} similar records)
duplicates.hint: Check before creating a new record. Duplicates split a patient's history.

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Every patient registered at the lab. Search by name, phone or patient number.
patients.newHint: Arabic name first; Latin letters are optional.

tests.search: Test code or name… (Enter adds the first match)

quote.emptyHint: Search above or pick from favourites and packages. Prices follow the chosen payer.

warn.title: Check the selection
warn.duplicate: {{code}} is already in the order; it is done once.
warn.packageCovered: Every test of {{code}} is already in the order, so the package was left out.
warn.overlap: {{analyte}} is measured by more than one test: {{tests}}.

order.title: Order
order.externalRefHint: The referring clinic's or client lab's own number.
order.clinicalInfoPlaceholder: Diagnosis, symptoms, medicines that matter for the results…
order.notFoundHint: It may have been typed wrongly, or it belongs to another lab.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Today's orders by default. Search by order number, patient name, phone or patient number.
orders.searchAllDates: Searching every date. Pick a date range to narrow it down.

overview.removeDescription: Only possible before any result is entered. The invoice is recalculated.

addTests.title: Add tests
addTests.description: To order {{accession}}. Tubes already drawn are reused when the sample type matches.
addTests.tubeHint: New tubes are only created when no existing tube fits; their labels can be printed right after.

cancel.title: Cancel order {{accession}}?
cancel.description: The tests and tubes of {{name}} are cancelled and the unpaid invoice is voided. This can't be undone.
cancel.descriptionPaid: The tests and tubes of {{name}} are cancelled. {{amount}} was already paid and will have to be refunded by the cashier.
cancel.refundDue: {{amount}} is due back to the patient.

cash.closedHint: Open a cash session to take cash, or choose another method.
cash.closedNoPermission: Ask a cashier to open a cash session, or choose another method.
cash.openDescription: Count the cash in the drawer before you start.

discount.title: Discount
discount.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. relative of a staff member, financial hardship
discount.directHint: You can approve discounts: it is applied at once.
discount.approvalHint: The request goes to a manager; the invoice changes once it is approved.
discount.willRequest: You can't approve discounts, so this goes for approval and isn't deducted yet.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.hint: Referral letters, ID copies and earlier results. Images or PDF, up to 10 MB.

trends.hint: Validated results only, oldest to newest. The shaded band is the reference range.
trends.emptyHint: Trends appear here once results are validated.

merge.title: Merge duplicate records
merge.description: When the same person was registered twice: their orders and attachments move to the record that stays.
merge.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. registered twice with a different spelling
merge.confirmHint: The merged record stays in the history but can't be used any more.
merge.mismatchTitle: The sex or birth date differ a lot
merge.mismatchHint: These may be two different people. Merge only if you are sure.

receipt.title: Payment receipt
receipt.accessHint: Enter your access code to see your results
